summary: DeSoto County, FL tower named Arcadia; Forest Lookouts lists it as removed. No build date, design or site description found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks the tower Removed; no date or method given

evidence.supports: the tower is listed under DeSoto County
the tower is listed in the Florida section of Forest Lookouts
Forest Lookouts marks the tower removed

notes_for_editor: The only source describing this tower is a three-line Forest Lookouts entry (DeSoto County, Removed). Checked and not useful: firetower.org Florida list (6 registered sites, Arcadia not among them, read at firetower.org/lookouts/us/FL); no Arcadia entry in the NHLR cache; firelookout.org Florida page gave no readable list; DeSoto County Historical Society and Florida Memory returned 403; the Wikipedia Arcadia article mentions only the 1905 town fire, which is not about a lookout, so it is not used. Story is well under 120 words because the evidence does not support more. Record coordinates were not checked against a second source.
